universe.eligibility: Four source ETF scheduled, 510300 excluded as source-only anchor; all baseline fields and the sole candidate finite. No old risk-shape all-three-candidates filter.
universe.warmup: 252 synchronized contiguous known OHLC rows for target and anchor
universe.missing: Missing/invalid/nonpositive own or anchor OHLC or unknown action resets synchronized 252 continuous warmup; no filling
universe.quality_gate: Reuse qualify_top_panel source-only V01 economic OHLC/action reconstruction
universe.degrade: Historical arrival and action-history completeness not independently certified; no sector or overseas extrapolation

validation.method: Independent logarithmic product identity, boundary, scale, prefix, gap, no-label qualification and source action reconstruction; synthetic rehearsal and later exact real comparison.
validation.limitations: Seen retrospective history; announcement arrival/action completeness unknown; no independent evidence or real open execution

research.price.overnight_minus_intraday2.name: 20日隔夜与日内经济价格变化之差
spec_anchor: 用户2026-10-03方向制定及2026-10-04继续授权；候选为研究扩展，非原文交易公式
LEI技术体系§2.4风险背景观察；不替换原判断

definition.endpoints: 21 contiguous close prices and last20 economic opens through t; future label is max(0,100*(1-min(C[t+1:t+21])/C[t+1]))
definition.direction: Positive means greater overnight than intraday change; risk relation estimated, no assumed trading direction
definition.transforms: Source economic OHLC: nominal*split multiplier plus effective cash, times previous economic/nominal-close scale. Both open and close include cash. Log partition is exact price-index identity, not actual trading gains. No normalization/tuning.

lifecycle.verification_scope: Independent product identity, mathematical cash/split/invalid cases, scale, causal prefix, no-label qualification, gap and snapshot boundaries; not proof of effectiveness.

research.price.overnight_minus_intraday2.origin: User-authorized same-ETF price composition, not a literal LEI rule
